title: Geek Bar Pulse Blow Pop Vape 15000 Puffs
description:
Enjoy Long-Lasting 15000 Puffs with Geek Bar Pulse Blow Pop Vape
Treat yourself to our newest creation, the Geek Bar Pulse 15000 puffs disposable vape in the delicious Blow Pop flavor. Savor the wonderful symphony of tastes. This is not your average vape; rather, it’s a journey down memory lane, with each puff capturing the joy of youth. With every inhalation, wave goodbye to monotonous vaping experiences and welcome to a rush of sugary sweetness.
Exploring Blow Pops Taste with Flavor Explosion
As you delve into the Geek Bar Pulse 15000, be ready for an intense flavor experience. You’ll be welcomed with the well-known flavor of your preferred Blow Pop lollipop with each pull.
Imagine what it would feel like to bite into that vibrant candy shell and then experience a burst of delicious fruit. Every flavor note, whether it’s the sweet grape, tart cherry, or zesty orange, is painstakingly created to provide a genuine and fulfilling vaping experience.
Elevate Your Taste Buds
Our carefully blended Blow Pop Geek Bar Pulse Vape flavored e-liquid replicates the classic flavor of the popular lollipop by blending only the best components. To guarantee the best possible flavor delivery and a smooth vaping experience, each component has been meticulously chosen. Every component, from carefully chosen flavorings to top-notch nicotine, works in unison to produce a delectable symphony that entices the senses.
Additional Features
Up to 15,000 regular puffs
Full-screen e-juice and battery life display
Made with salt nic e-juice
Pre-filled & pre-charged
5% nicotine by weight (50mg/mL)
Dual Core
Dual Mesh Coil
Bite-friendly mouthpiece
Up to 7,500 pulse puffs
FAQ
Is the Geek Bar Pulse Blow Pop suitable for beginners?
Yes, its user-friendly design and nostalgic flavor profile make it suitable for both beginners and experienced vapers.
What makes the Blow Pop flavor unique in the Geek Bar Pulse?
The flavor replicates the classic Blow Pop lollipop, delivering a burst of sugary sweetness and fruity notes with each puff.
What flavors can I expect from the Geek Bar Pulse Blow Pop?
The vape mimics the taste of a Blow Pop lollipop, with notes of sweet grape, tart cherry, and zesty orange.
Does the Geek Bar Pulse Blow Pop have any special features?
Yes, it has a full-screen display for e-juice and battery life, a dual core, dual mesh coil, and a bite-friendly mouthpiece.
